import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long p, k;
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[1000006];
    static long answer;

    static long power_mod(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        for (int i = 30; i >= 0; i--) {
            result = (result * result) % 1000000007;
            if (((1L << i) & exp) != 0) {
                result = (result * base) % 1000000007;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        answer = 0;
        p = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(power_mod(p, p));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        for (long i = 1; i < p; i++) {
            if (!visited[(int)i]) {
                visited[(int)i] = true;
                answer++;
                long current = (i * k) % p;
                while (!visited[(int)current]) {
                    visited[(int)current] = true;
                    current = (current * k) % p;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(power_mod(p, answer));
        sc.close();
    }
}
